Players Committee card image of [[Starkiller Base: Shield Control]] (original printing), game text: “'''Light Side:''' Chewie, Finn, and Han are deploy -1 and power +1 here. '''Dark Side:''' If you control with a First Order leader, Force drain +1 here.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual8-Dark/large/starkillerbaseshieldcontrol.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 022435b] (8 July 2018). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
